resources.string: Ready. Tap Start to scan. Scanning continues with screen off and auto-resumes after reboot.

Policy: All sectors/bits are treated as UNHEALTHY unless verified healthy by a completed scan. If the phone powers off/restarts during a scan, the in-progress sector/bit is marked PERMANENTLY UNUSABLE and is never rescanned. The app keeps a persistent healthy/bad sector map. Scanning runs in the background (screen off OK) and auto-resumes after crash/reboot. After scanning, the app automatically quarantines bad files, exports reports, and tags bad sectors when safe (root + unmounted). Note: Android apps cannot force other apps to use specific physical sectors; OS/filesystem-level enforcement requires root/system support. Raw block scans require root.
